text:
Maya - PMM: Pushed a tightened launch blog draft to drive. Need a 24h quick-pass: content polish, hero image, legal on the headline claim, and confirm webinar RSVP flow.
Eli - Content: Draft link: https://drive.google.com/redwood-launch-edit. Focus: problem (serving cost/latency), how Redwood solves it, a compact benchmark, CTA to webinar.
Zoe - Design: Can we show cost-per-token bars + tiny latency sparkline in hero? Prefer SVG so it scales. Send CSV and I'll mock two variants.
Ravi - Growth: Webinar options: Tue 9am PT or Thu 11am PT. Recommend Tue for APAC. Proposed UTMs: utm_source=rw_blog&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=launch_apr2026&utm_content=register_cta.
Hana - Legal: Avoid absolute claims without method. Use: "in our internal tests, we saw up to 65% lower per-token spend vs baseline" and link to method doc. Label any placeholder quote as "beta customer".
Eli - Content: Updated headline per Hana and added bench footnote: https://internal.redwood/perf/2026-apr-launch. Bench caption: "Baseline: open-8B, 128-token evals. Redwood: quant8 + smart-batching."
Noah - Ops: Created provisional HubSpot form id=hs_launch_apr_03 and added hidden UTM fields. Workflow: if interest=="dedicated" -> Team_Dedicated else -> inbound_pool. Need final field names before finalizing.
calendar-bot: Provisional event created: "Redwood Launch Webinar  Tue 2026-04-14 09:00 PT". Zoom: https://zoom.example/redwood-apr2026. RSVP: https://redwood.com/events/launch-apr
Maya - PMM: Plan: Zoe posts hero variants in #design-review today, Hana quick sign by 3pm, Ravi seeds calendar copy + UTMs, Noah wires HubSpot. I'll do final read before publish. :sparkles:
